home.role: Third-year undergraduate in Mathematics · Embodied AI
home.about:
I am currently a research intern in [Prof. Li Yuan](https://yuanli2333.github.io/)'s group at Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School, and am mentored by [Dr. Kai Wang](https://kaiwang960112.github.io/) at Tencent. Previously, I was a research assistant at the [MINT Lab](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/) at SJTU and in [Prof. Taku Komura](https://i.cs.hku.hk/~taku/)'s group at HKU.

My research interests lie in **embodied AI**, particularly how a single robot policy can keep extending to new tasks and embodiments. In [MorphAct](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/MorphAct.io/), we found that different manipulation skills pull shared parameters in conflicting directions, so we let the policy generate parameters for its perception and action modules from the current context. In [Evo-Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14950) (NeurIPS 2026), we extract implicit depth from RGB to give a VLA better spatial perception. At HKU, I worked on cross-embodiment action retargeting, turning human–object interactions into executable motions for dexterous hands and robot arms.
home.seeking: I am applying for research master's and PhD programs starting in 2028. Feel free to get in touch.

publications.title: MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In
publications.authors: Ziyan Liu\*, **Jiting Liu**\*, Weihong Zhong\*, Wenda Yu, Yeqiu Chen, Jason Li, Xiaojiang Peng, Shuyuan Hu, Kai Wang, Bo Zhao
publications.imageAlt: MorphAct teaser: the policy generates parameters for its perception and action modules from the interaction context.
publications.summary: On 65 RoboCasa365 atomic tasks, each parameter update raises the loss of 22–46 other tasks. MorphAct uses two coupled generators that produce low-rank updates for the VLM and the action module from the current observation, instruction and robot state.
publications.contribution: Built the parameter-generation module and ported it to X-VLA, π0 and π0.5: Meta-World success rises by 7.57, 16.30 and 15.72 points.

publications.title: Evo-Depth: A Lightweight Depth-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Model
publications.authors: Tao Lin\*, Yuxin Du\*, **Jiting Liu**\*, Nuobei Zhu, Yunhe Li, Yuqian Fu, Yinxinyu Chen, Hongyi Cai, Zewei Ye, Bing Cheng, Kai Ye, Yiran Mao, Yilei Zhong, MingKang Dong, Junchi Yan, Gen Li, Bo Zhao
publications.imageAlt: Evo-Depth architecture: implicit depth encoding, spatial enhancement and action prediction.
publications.summary: No depth camera needed: implicit depth features from RGB are injected into the vision-language representation with FiLM. Meta-World 84.4% (Evo-1: 80.6%), LIBERO 95.4%, LIBERO-Plus 69.6% (π0-FAST: 53.6%).
publications.contribution: Proposed the FiLM-style depth injection; led the model design, implementation and main experiments.
